provenance.rule: each region is its box minus every box before it (feeds.region_of, first match wins), cut to the water; the box stays the unit the monitor measures by, and the drawing inherits Natural Earth's choice of coastline

water.source: Natural Earth 1:10m ocean (ne_10m_ocean.geojson), public domain; it draws the Caspian Sea as ocean, and other inland water inside a box is not drawn
